fields.description: This luxurious one-bedroom apartment is pet friendly and situated on the 13th floor, fitted out to provide the best living experience possible. It has a generously sized open living space with floor to ceiling windows, one double bedroom with built-in wardrobe, a high quality kitchen with lots of storage space and integrated appliances. The apartment is furnished with private parking spaces available for an additional fee (POA). There also is a secure bike storage which includes a fully kitted workshop.
